annotation.title_clean: NRS Chapter 493 - General Provisions (Uniform State Law for Aeronautics; Unmanned Aerial Vehicles)
annotation.title_en: Nevada Revised Statutes Chapter 493 - General Provisions (Aeronautics, incl. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles)
annotation.summary_en: Nevada statute chapter on aeronautics (Uniform State Law for Aeronautics) with extensive unmanned aerial vehicle provisions: trespass actions with treble damages, weaponization felony, restrictions near critical facilities and airports, warrant requirements for police drones, and a public-agency drone registry and foreign-vendor procurement restrictions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Weaponizing a UAV is a category D felony; category C if the weapon is discharged
UAV operation prohibited within 500 ft of critical facilities and within 5 miles of airports without consent or authorization
Law enforcement needs a warrant (max 10 days) for UAV surveillance where privacy is expected, subject to exceptions
Department of Public Safety maintains registry of public-agency UAVs and bans acquisition from listed foreign entities
Landowners may sue UAV operators for trespass below 250 ft with treble damages
